dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hello there, dear passenger. Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When does the aquabus head out?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: O—Oh, right! It's time to go already, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Okay. Just call me if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hmm. I'll introduce myself officially once we're underway, but guess there's no harm doing it now! I'm Aeval, and I'm in charge of introducing the Clementine Line!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Are you curious about us Melusines, dear passenger? Mm-hmm, I get it — they say that there aren't any Melusines anywhere else in Teyvat, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, the secret we Melusines keep is...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Well, I don't know either! I've just heard that we're a very young race — we've only been around for something over four hundred years.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: It was Monsieur Neuvillette who brought us from the cavern of Elynas to the Court of Fontaine, to live with everyone else. That's why I'm here, in this smart uniform, giving this explanation!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this ship...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: This? This is an aquabus — the most advanced transportation device in Fontaine... Probably!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I've heard that some people are working on a boat that can fly in the sky. That sounds awesome, right? If boats really could do that...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Wait, that's bad! That would cause... seasick? Airsick? Either way, passengers who get sick will be in great danger.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When does the aquabus head out?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: O—Oh, right! It's time to go already, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Okay. Just call me if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hello there, dear passenger. Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When does the aquabus head out?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: O—Oh, right! It's time to go already, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Okay. Just call me if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's our destination this time?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Right. Our destination is Romaritime Station, which is also Romaritime Harbor — which is the end of a large waterfall!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: And opposite that big waterfall... Well, that's a big desert! Uh, is that where you want to go, dear passenger? That's... super amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the Melusines?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't been back to Merusea Village in ages. I wonder how everyone's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: By the way, that's our hometown! It was where we lived before we came to the Court of Fontaine. Everyone there's really nice. Especially Serene — she's like a big sister to us all!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: There's Lutine, who makes awesome food, and Topyas and Canotila... Actually, I wonder how they're doing? Guess I should write them a letter, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm also a bit worried about Mamere... Speaking of which...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When does the aquabus head out?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: O—Oh, right! It's time to go already, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Okay. Just call me if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *cough* Could I ask when the aquabus heads out?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: O—Oh, right! Sorry, I really didn't mean to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's talk again later...)

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hello there, dear passenger. Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the aquabuses...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're way too fast!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I—I see. Feedback noted! I'll report it to the higher-ups. Thank you for your suggestion...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: "She" is not that young anymore, I'm afraid. I've heard that the aquabuses are converted small naval boats from Fontaine's navy after it got disbanded.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: They were way faster when first converted than they are now — they got slowed down to keep operational costs low. I'll keep your suggestion in mind and pass the feedback on, though!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're kinda slow...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: That's true... Feedback noted! I'll report it to the higher-ups!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: "She" is not that young anymore, I'm afraid. I've heard that the aquabuses are converted small naval boats from Fontaine's navy after it got disbanded.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: They were way faster when first converted than they are now — they got slowed down to keep operational costs low. I'll keep your suggestion in mind and pass the feedback on, though!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Court of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Yup! That's my favorite place — wait, no, it's probably my second-favorite...? The place I love most is still Merusea Village, I reckon!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: That's our homeland — a warm and comfy place. It's not as big or as pretty as the Court of Fontaine, but I actually get a bit scared of having so many pretty things and big houses around sometimes...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Ah, um, sorry! About the Court... You're a traveler, aren't you, dear passenger? In which case, you should go pay Lady Furina a visit — by that, I mean the Statue of The Seven!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Other than that, I really love Café Lutece! When I'm free, I often sit there with my senior, who always takes good care of me, and we take in the scent of coffee!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: As for Hotel Debord... Well, it's not really to my tastes, but it's recommended by the official guide, so I'm sure it's alright!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Bertin's House of Curiosities and Chioriya Boutique are also pretty good! That senior of mine who I go coffee-smelling with often gets clothes made there, though we usually don't have much opportunity to wear them...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: As for the rest... Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Right! Once you go leave Hotel Debord, you can head straight to reach The Steambird publishing house! Feel free to subscribe to them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, Ms. Aeval!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: See you, dear passenger, and thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the route...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this area...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Yup, we've reached our destination, Romaritime Station, which is also Romaritime Harbor. Strictly speaking, the former's part of the latter, and is a station on this route!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Other than that... Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: (Uh oh, what do I do! There's nothing here in the official guide! C'mon, Aeval, you can't let the passenger down like that! C'mon!)

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Err, right, there's also a famous big waterfall here! See? There's tons of water, so the waterfall's way big! And because it's way big, lots of water flows down it, and as the water flowing down increases, the water will decrease...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: ...Eh? Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, Ms. Aeval!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: See you, dear passenger, and thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Make sure you have enough water on you if you visit the desert!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The trip was way too short!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Ah! Dear passenger...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I definitely agree! It's a wonderful thing, isn't it? Traveling on the elevated aquabus lane, taking in the sights here in Fontaine, growing old with the aquabus...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Um, but changing the route might be kinda tough. Uh, maybe we could slow the boat down a bit? That way, the time taken will increase. Hehe, Aeval, you're so smart! That's what we'll suggest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The trip was way too long!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: That's true... Feedback noted! I'll report it to the higher-ups!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I've heard that Poisson is the hometown of the person who built the line, which is why the Clementine Line was made to pass through Mont Automnequi during the planning stages.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Going through the mountain is super exciting — and that's why the Poisson Tunnel we went through was carved.

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: But that choice does also make sense. The land over at Elynas is not very stable, and since the seabed at Elton Trench is unsuitable, we can't just come over the water either!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: So, all that is to say that changing the route might be a bit hard, so we could... make the boats faster? That way, we'd shorten travel time! Hmm, but what about explanation time...
